title: ArcCivs organic settlement density proposal and safe-site recovery
assumptions: Preview proposal only. Active 0.1.69 retains eleven ordinary autonomous sites and ordinary cap 16. This assessment does not establish runtime activation of the V2 density proposal.

Proposed V2 target: 28 ordinary buildings, 20 HOUSE plus 8 existing service buildings. Before: 3 HOUSE plus 8 services, 11 total. Proposed autonomous hard cap 32; player-town cap 16, population cap 12, producer counts, cycle outputs, food/recruitment rates and stock limits remain unchanged.

HOUSE L1 remains 24 abstract wood, 12 abstract stone and zero food. Seventeen additional paid houses consume 408 wood and 204 stone once. House-only target costs change from 72 wood/36 stone to 480 wood/240 stone. Accepted order prices and receipts remain unchanged.
Each HOUSE L1 has 3 beds. House capacity changes 9 to 60 beds, delta 51. Population remains 12; capacity grants no residents, production, items or equipment.
Auto wood/stone/food remain abstract stocks without item or currency redemption. Empty template containers add capacity only. Player construction continues to pay its exact native schematic bill.

Low/base/high assumptions: 1/5/10 villages completing one expansion each spend 408/2040/4080 abstract wood and 204/1020/2040 stone per once-only cohort. These are scenarios, not measured daily or weekly utilization. Retry and crash recovery must not duplicate payment.

No measured disposable income or work hours are inferred. Unchanged ideal L1 output is 4 wood and 3 stone per 60-second fed active cycle: additional stock needs at least 102 wood cycles and 68 stone cycles. Walking, night and storage reduce actual rate; parallel producer time is not summed.

Infrastructure prices remain wall 8 wood/16 stone, gate 12/16, road 0/8. V2 infrastructure counts and total cost are pending the actual export; this assessment does not authorize changing its cap without counting.

No boost, stacking or buy-craft-sell ratio is added. Current SELL and future SELL-to-contract transition remain unchanged. Direct deltas separately zero Vault, zero tokens and zero player XP. No sale value is invented.

V1 safe-site fallback and movement corrections restore intended progress at unchanged nominal costs, outputs and limits. Realized throughput is unmeasured. Fluids, occupied/foreign blocks and live protection remain exclusions.
